verdict.rationale: The Division of Revenue states up front that you must create an account before starting business license registration. That is a thin, first-party disclosure of one prerequisite. The probe confirms that filings sit behind an authenticated session, but nothing in the evidence spells out credential requirements or identity-proofing steps before the flow begins. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of credential and login requirements, any statement of identity-proofing or verification steps, a pre-flow checklist covering filing (not just license registration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Create an account with us to begin your business license registration or renew your existing business licenses.
